description: This file contains the implementation of the CustomerServicesImpl class which provides user detail services for customer authentication within a Spring Security context. It interacts with customer, permission, and group services to load user data and authorities based on username.

classes.name: CustomerServicesImpl
classes.description: Implementation of Spring Security's UserDetailsService to load user-specific data for authentication based on Customer entity.

methods.name: loadUserByUsername
methods.description: Loads user details and authorities for a given username, performing database lookups and permission assignment, returning a UserDetails object.
